title: BigP3BCI Study N — 9x8 dry/wet electrode comparison (8 ALS subjects)
description: This dataset is a derivative subset of the bigP3BCI collection (Study N). It contains 16-channel EEG recorded at 256 Hz from 8 participants with amyotrophic lateral sclerosis, who used a P300-based speller with a 9x8 character grid. Each participant completed two sessions comparing dry and wet electrodes. Target and non-target stimulus events are annotated with HED tags. The data support evaluation of P300 detection and BCI speller performance in a clinical population.
methods_description: EEG was recorded with a g.USBamp amplifier (g.tec) from 16 channels at 256 Hz, using a standard 10-20 montage and a 60 Hz line frequency. Participants used a visual P300 speller with a 9x8 grid and online feedback. Each participant had two sessions, comparing dry and wet electrodes. Data are labeled as Target or NonTarget events, with a calibration-then-test evaluation scheme.
